description:
## Goal

Retire invalid PR #123 and rebuild the recalculator stack on code that actually contains every closed prerequisite. No compiler ticket may start from a branch where bw says a prerequisite is closed but its commit is absent.

## Required state

- Preserve current .200/.220 working material and parked candidates only as recoverable research; do not land them wholesale.
- Close PR #123 as invalid. Neither fz-kdt.214 nor fz-kdt.75 is carried as architecture.
- Keep PR #121 as the denotational-list predecessor.
- Reconcile PR #122 onto the accepted current #121 head. PR #122 contains fz-kdt.183, .199, .210 and other code required by the revised semantic plan.
- PR #124 remains independent concordant cleanup and may land separately.
- Create a clean recalculator branch above the accepted #122 boundary. The first accepted implementation ticket opens a new draft PR with gh stacks; ticket 11 starts the next stacked PR.
- Push a completed ticket only when the preceding pushed head is green. Work may continue locally while CI runs.

## Acceptance

The new branch contains the exact accepted #121 and #122 histories, contains neither invalid #123 commit, has a clean tracked worktree, and all protected untracked measurements and recoverable stashes remain intact. The epic description and dependency graph tell only the revised plan. A cold graph audit confirms that bw ready exposes no implementation before this gate closes.
title: Rebuild the recalculator stack above accepted PR #122
